Tasks can operate your selected apps. If you are using the phone, execution pauses for confirmation. Stop and takeover always cancel control.

With your consent, tasks may enter your saved PIN or password locally. It never goes to the model or diagnostic reports. Failed attempts require your help. The phone locks again only if the task unlocked it and you have not taken over. Pattern locks and some system screens need manual help.
